name: Kohinata Takako
source:
A student at the academy and the head of its disciplinary committee. She is the principal's niece. She always carry with her a golden sceptre with an eagle.

[Translated from [url=http://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noel]the Russian Wikipedia[/url].]
